scenario_name: Shanghai Jiaozhou Road urban fire rescue route planning with AMap data
description: Road geometry and traffic status come from AMap Web Service. Fire risk is generated by overlaying the Shanghai Jiaozhou Road historical fire response buffer with road polylines.
historical_event_name: 2010 Shanghai Jiaozhou Road high-rise fire response zone
risk_design_note: For urban fire response, the destination is inside the incident area, so fire-affected road segments are penalized but remain passable. Congested and blocked roads from AMap traffic status increase the safe-path cost. A fixed control cost is also added for each fire or congestion segment to model lane occupation, traffic control, and emergency vehicle passing difficulty.
